configuration.declaration_status: computational specification saved before Monte Carlo; not public preregistration
configuration.inputs: iid N(0,I6), independent between channels, splits and replicates
configuration.noise: iid N(0,sigma^2) in every physical output coordinate
configuration.alternative: independent SO(3) left/right orientations per channel and replicate; readable blocks held fixed across splits
configuration.alternative_scope: independent rank-two readable blocks inside all fixed map ranges; ensemble-specific, not local or worst-case power
configuration.common_estimator: pooled unconstrained OLS K, followed by Frobenius rank-two SVD truncation
configuration.common_statistic: physical held-out sum of squared residuals divided by known sigma^2
configuration.conditional_comparator: independent unrestricted 3x3 readable blocks fitted by calibration OLS; dimension 36
configuration.score_difference: T_independent - T_common; positive means better common held-out Gaussian log score; log-score difference is half this value
configuration.comparison_scope: descriptive only; no evidence gate, standard-physics test or complete-protocol success claimed
configuration.capacity_denominator: 36: independent kernels conditional on all frozen readable ranges
configuration.capacity_interpretation: combined common-bridge and rank-two restrictions relative to independent unrestricted readable blocks
configuration.secondary_capacity_reference: independent rank-two readable blocks have dimension 4*8=32; 8/32=.25, reported without changing the declared comparator
configuration.data_denominator: 360: calibration scalar outputs retained by the rank-three output maps; sigma and maps are known
configuration.size_scope: pointwise at the frozen common truth; not uniform over the composite null
configuration.interval: pointwise two-sided Wilson 95%, conditional on the realized frozen MC threshold; excludes threshold uncertainty
configuration.map_draw_order: channel index increasing; output 6x3 isometry then input 6x3 isometry, transposed
configuration.rotation_rule: signed QR with nonnegative R diagonal, then flip final column if determinant is negative
configuration.alternative_draw_order: channel index increasing; left SO(3) orientation then right SO(3) orientation
configuration.replicate_draw_order: alternative blocks if applicable; X_cal; noise_cal; X_test; noise_test
configuration.figure: shared 160-bin histograms of log10(T/threshold), all independent evaluation replicates, no tail clipping

design_verification.calibration_count_interpretation: independent informative scalar output observations conditional on inputs/maps; not Fisher-information or design-matrix rank

null_size.interval_scope: pointwise two-sided Wilson 95%, conditional on the realized frozen MC threshold; excludes threshold uncertainty

alternative_power.interval_scope: pointwise two-sided Wilson 95%, conditional on the realized frozen MC threshold; excludes threshold uncertainty

descriptive_predictive_comparison.scope: descriptive only; no evidence gate, standard-physics test or complete-protocol success claimed
descriptive_predictive_comparison.sign_convention: T_independent - T_common; positive means better common held-out Gaussian log score; log-score difference is half this value
